description: This file declares an interface class 'IAVBufferHelper' for managing buffer memory, including mapping, unmapping, and copying data between handles. It provides method signatures for operations related to buffer handling in a media or data processing context.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: Abstract interface for buffer management, including memory mapping, unmapping, size querying, and secure handle operations.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a given handle to a CPU address space, returning a pointer to the mapped memory and its size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with a given handle.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory associated with a handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer identified by a handle.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure buffers using specified offset mappings.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
